{"file_path":"scripts/core/BattleManager.gd","new_string":"# 字号统一走 UiKit 档位（FS_XS..FS_HUGE）× 全局 scale
func _sel_fs(tier: int) -> int:
	return int(round(tier * UiKit.scale()))

func _sel_btn_style(color: Color, hovered: bool, filled: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	return UiKit.skin_button("hover" if hovered else "normal", color, filled)

func _sel_btn(text: String, color: Color, filled: bool = false, min_size: Vector2 = Vector2(560, 76)) -> Button:
	var b := Button.new()
	b.text = text
	b.custom_minimum_size = min_size
	b.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", _sel_fs(UiKit.FS_LG))
	b.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _sel_btn_style(color, false, filled))
	b.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _sel_btn_style(color, true, filled))
	b.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", UiKit.skin_button("pressed", color, filled))
	b.add_theme_stylebox_override("disabled", UiKit.skin_button("disabled", color, filled))
	b.add_theme_color_override("font_color", SEL_TEXT)
	b.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", Color.WHITE)
	b.add_theme_color_override("font_pressed_color", Color.WHITE)
	b.add_theme_color_override("font_disabled_color", SEL_DIM)
	return b

func _style_card(card: Panel, base_color: Color, selected: bool) -> void:
	if card == null: return
	card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", UiKit.skin_card(base_color, selected, 0.88 if selected else 0.72))

func _sel_summ_name(sid: String) -> String:
	match sid:
		"flash": return "闪现"
		"sprint": return "疾跑"
		"teleport": return "传送"
		"heal": return "治疗术"
		"execute": return "终结"
		"frenzy": return "狂暴"
		"stun": return "晕眩"
		"cleanse_summoner": return "净化"
		"weaken": return "弱化"
		"smite": return "惩击"
	return sid

func _sel_skill_type(t: int) -> String:
	match t:
		0: return "指向"
		1: return "范围"
		2: return "增益"
		3: return "线性"
		4: return "位移"
		5: return "多段"
		6: return "护盾"
	return "通用"","old_string":"func _sel_btn_style(color: Color, hovered: bool) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var edge := Color(0.85, 0.85, 0.95, 0.25 if hovered else 0.12)
	var sb := UiKit.flat(1.0, 10, 1, edge, color, 26.0)
	sb.content_margin_top = 10
	sb.content_margin_bottom = 10
	return sb

func _sel_card_style(color: Color, hovered: bool) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var edge := Color(0.9, 0.9, 1.0, 0.3 if hovered else 0.15)
	var sb := UiKit.flat(1.0, 8, 1, edge, color, 8.0)
	sb.content_margin_top = 6
	sb.content_margin_bottom = 6
	return sb

func _sel_btn(text: String, color: Color) -> Button:
	var b := Button.new()
	b.text = text
	b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(560, 76)
	b.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 28)
	b.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _sel_btn_style(color, false))
	b.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _sel_btn_style(color.lightened(0.18), true))
	b.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", _sel_btn_style(color.darkened(0.25), false))
	b.add_theme_color_override("font_color", SEL_TEXT)
	b.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", Color.WHITE)
	return b

func _style_card(card: Panel, base_color: Color, selected: bool) -> void:
	var style = card.get_theme_stylebox("panel", "Panel") as StyleBoxFlat
	if not style: return
	style.bg_color = base_color.lightened(0.25) if selected else base_color
	style.border_color = SEL_GOLD if selected else UiKit.C_PANEL_EDGE
	style.set_border_width_all(3 if selected else 1)"}

{"file_path":"scripts/core/BattleManager.gd","new_string":"# 中栏英雄预览：名称/职责标签/技能说明/基础属性（预览时调用，不改选人状态）
func _refresh_sel_preview(hero_name: String) -> void:
	if sel_prev_name == null: return
	var cfg: Dictionary = hero_configs.get(hero_name, {})
	if cfg.is_empty(): return
	var role: String = str(cfg.get("role", ""))
	var role_color: Color = ROLE_COLORS.get(role, UiKit.C_TEAM0)
	sel_prev_name.text = hero_name
	sel_prev_name.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color.WHITE)
	if sel_prev_role_label:
		sel_prev_role_label.text = "定位 · " + role
		sel_prev_role_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", role_color.lightened(0.35))
	if sel_prev_role_chip:
		sel_prev_role_chip.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", UiKit.skin_chip(role_color, 0.95, 12))
	if sel_prev_info_label:
		sel_prev_info_label.text = "推荐召唤师 · " + _sel_summ_name(str(cfg.get("summoner", "flash")))
	if sel_prev_info_chip:
		sel_prev_info_chip.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", UiKit.skin_chip(UiKit.C_GOLD, 0.9, 12))
	# 技能 1/2/3（+被动）
	if sel_prev_skill_box:
		for c in sel_prev_skill_box.get_children():
			sel_prev_skill_box.remove_child(c)
			c.queue_free()
		var skills: Array = cfg.get("skills", [])
		for i in skills.size():
			var sk: Skill = SkillDatabase.get_skill(str(skills[i]))
			var row := PanelContainer.new()
			row.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 92)
			row.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
			row.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", UiKit.skin_chip(UiKit.C_TEAM0, 0.58, 12))
			var h := HBoxContainer.new()
			h.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 16)
			var key := _sel_label(str(i + 1), _sel_fs(UiKit.FS_XL), UiKit.C_GOLD)
			key.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(64, 0)
			key.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
			h.add_child(key)
			var info := VBoxContainer.new()
			info.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
			info.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
			info.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 2)

	for c in sel_hero_strip.get_children():
		sel_hero_strip.remove_child(c)
		c.queue_free()
	selected_hero_card = null
	for hero_name in hero_configs:
		var cfg: Dictionary = hero_configs[hero_name]
		var role: String = str(cfg.get("role", ""))
		if sel_active_role != "全部" and role != sel_active_role: continue
		var role_color: Color = ROLE_COLORS.get(role, Color.GRAY)
		var card := _create_hero_card(hero_name, role, role_color)

extends Node

var t := 0
var bm: BattleManager = null
var tur: Turret = null
var mn: Minion = null
var mm: JungleMonster = null

func _ready() -> void:
	add_child((load("res://scenes/battle.tscn") as PackedScene).instantiate())

func _process(_d: float) -> void:
	t += 1
	if t == 20:
		bm = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager") as BattleManager
		if bm != null:
			bm._start_game("亚瑟")
	elif t == 320:
		tur = bm.turrets[0] as Turret
		mn = Minion.new()
		mn.setup({"name": "melee", "team": 1, "max_health": 999999, "attack": 1})
		mn.position = tur.position + Vector3(5.0, 0.0, 0.0)
		add_child(mn)
		tur.current_target = mn
	elif t == 340:
		var beam = tur.get("_lock_beam")
		print("B t340 visible=", beam != null and is_instance_valid(beam) and (beam as Node3D).visible)
	elif t == 400:
		var beam2 = tur.get("_lock_beam")
		var vis: bool = beam2 != null and is_instance_valid(beam2) and (beam2 as Node3D).visible
		print("B t400 visible=", vis)
		if vis:
			var mid: Vector3 = (beam2 as MeshInstance3D).global_transform.origin
			var want: Vector3 = (tur.global_position + Vector3(0, 2, 0) + mn.global_position + Vector3(0, 1, 0)) * 0.5
			print("B midpoint_err=", "%.2f" % mid.distance_to(want), " len=", "%.2f" % (beam2 as MeshInstance3D).scale.y, " tower_to_target=", "%.2f" % (tur.global_position + Vector3(0,2,0)).distance_to(mn.global_position + Vector3(0,1,0)))
		mn.queue_free()
		mn = null
	elif t == 430:
		var beam3 = tur.get("_lock_beam")
		print("B t430 after_target_gone visible=", beam3 != null and is_instance_valid(beam3) and (beam3 as Node3D).visible)
		get_tree().quit()

	# 亮核 + 双层菲涅尔光晕；生成时弹性放大，再飞向目标英雄

	orb.position = world_pos + Vector3.UP * 1.0
	orb.scale = Vector3(0.35, 0.35, 0.35)
	add_child(orb)

	var tween = create_tween()

{"file_path":"C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king\scripts\core\BattleManager.gd","old_string":"func _start_game_body(hero_type: String, summoner_id: String = "flash"):
	# 进入对局：淡出大厅环境音乐
	SfxManager.stop_menu_music()
	_clear_prewarm_protos()
	selected_hero_type = hero_type
	hero_selected = true
	# 随机分配玩家阵营：红方出生时镜头整体旋转 180°，手感与蓝方一致
	if NetSession.mode == NetSession.Mode.NONE:
		Config.roll_player_team()
	cam_yaw = PI if Config.player_team == Config.Team.ENEMY else 0.0
	cam.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-60, rad_to_deg(cam_yaw), 0)
	# 调试：默认开启AI路径小球显示（F4可切换）
	GameEntity.debug_show_path = true
	print("[Debug] AI路径球显示已开启（F4切换）")
	print("[Debug] 击杀奖励调试日志已开启（BattleManager.debug_kill_rewards）")
	# 销毁选择UI
	if select_ui:
		select_ui.queue_free()
		select_ui = null

	# 创建实体：BP 结果传入（我方 AI 按号位顺序排除玩家席位；网络 host 路径数组为空→原随机）
	_create_player_hero(hero_type, summoner_id)          # 玩家英雄
	sel_ally_ai_picks = []
	if sel_ally_picks.size() == 5:
		for i in 5:
			if i != sel_player_seat and str(sel_ally_picks[i]) != "":
				sel_ally_ai_picks.append(str(sel_ally_picks[i]))
	_create_team_ai(Config.player_team, 4, [], sel_ally_ai_picks)  # 4个己方AI
	_create_team_ai(Config.foe_team(), 5, [], sel_enemy_picks)    # 5个敌方AI
	sel_ally_picks = []
	sel_enemy_picks = []
	sel_taken = {}
	_create_turrets()
	_create_jungle()

	# 元流之子·万物为流：玩家开局泉水四选一（弹出面板，AI 已在生成时随机选好）

func _add_wall_chain(pts: Array, pillar: bool = true, open_ends: bool = false) -> void:
	if pts.size() < 2:

new = '''func _emit_wall_chain(pts: Array, pillar: bool, open_ends: bool) -> void:
	if pts.size() < 2:
		return
	# 记录“实际落位”的连续段：被过滤掉的段会断开链，端柱只补在真实端头，避免悬空柱子
	var run_start := Vector3.ZERO
	var run_end := Vector3.ZERO
	var in_run := false
	for i in range(pts.size() - 1):
		var p0: Vector3 = pts[i]
		var p1: Vector3 = pts[i + 1]
		var delta := p1 - p0
		var seg := delta.length()
		if seg < 0.05:
			continue
		var mid := (p0 + p1) * 0.5
		var tangent := delta / seg
		# 墙面法线：切线绕 Y 轴转 90°（墙长沿局部 X、局部 +Z 为正面朝向）
		var normal := Vector3(tangent.z, 0.0, -tangent.x)
		var placed := _add_wall(mid, normal.normalized(), false, false, false, 2.0, seg + 0.12, false, open_ends)

'''

# ---------------- 开局地面推荐分路指引 ----------------
# 蓝（我方）/ 红（敌方）各画三条路的地面光带 + 方向箭头，玩家英雄对应分路加粗高亮；
# 12 秒后淡出释放，避免干扰对线期视野。
const LANE_GUIDE_HOLD := 12.0
const LANE_GUIDE_FADE := 1.6

func _spawn_lane_guides() -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(hero):
		return
	var root := Node3D.new()
	root.name = "LaneGuide"
	add_child(root)
	var blue := Color(0.30, 0.68, 1.0)
	var red := Color(1.0, 0.34, 0.28)
	# 己方（蓝）基地在 (-53,53)，敌方（红）基地在 (53,-53)
	var my_lane := _lane_for_role(str(hero.role))     # 玩家推荐分路
	# 我方三条路
	_add_lane_guide(root, [Vector3(-53, 0, 53), Vector3(-35, 0, 55), Vector3(-15, 0, 56), Vector3(28, 0, 58)],
		blue, my_lane == "farm")
	_add_lane_guide(root, [Vector3(-53, 0, 53), Vector3(-40, 0, 40), Vector3(-27, 0, 27), Vector3(-14, 0, 14)],
		blue, my_lane == "mid")
	_add_lane_guide(root, [Vector3(-53, 0, 53), Vector3(-55, 0, 35), Vector3(-56, 0, 15), Vector3(-58, 0, -28)],
		blue, my_lane == "clash")
	# 敌方三条路（镜像）
	_add_lane_guide(root, [Vector3(53, 0, -53), Vector3(35, 0, -55), Vector3(15, 0, -56), Vector3(-28, 0, -58)],
		red, false)
	_add_lane_guide(root, [Vector3(53, 0, -53), Vector3(40, 0, -40), Vector3(27, 0, -27), Vector3(14, 0, -14)],
		red, false)
	_add_lane_guide(root, [Vector3(53, 0, -53), Vector3(55, 0, -35), Vector3(56, 0, -15), Vector3(58, 0, 28)],
		red, false)
	# 双方泉水标记环：蓝圈 = 我方，红圈 = 敌方
	for pair in [[Vector3(-53, 0, 53), blue], [Vector3(53, 0, -53), red]]:
		var ring := MeshFactory.create_torus_ring(3.6, 4.4, pair[1], true, 0.55, true)
		ring.position = Vector3(pair[0].x, 0.18, pair[0].z)
		ring.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
		root.add_child(ring)
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_interval(LANE_GUIDE_HOLD)
	tw.tween_method(func(v: float):
		if not is_instance_valid(root):
			return
		for c in root.get_children():
			if c is GeometryInstance3D:
				(c as GeometryInstance3D).transparency = v
	, 0.0, 1.0, LANE_GUIDE_FADE)
	tw.tween_callback(root.queue_free)

func _lane_for_role(role: String) -> String:
	match role:
		"射手":
			return "farm"
		"法师":
			return "mid"
		"刺客", "辅助":
			return "mid"     # 打野/游走以中路河道为主轴
		_:
			return "clash"   # 战士 / 坦克 → 对抗路

func _add_lane_guide(parent: Node3D, pts: Array, color: Color, highlight: bool) -> void:
	var width: float = 4.2 if highlight else 2.6
	var alpha: float = 0.60 if highlight else 0.34
	var y: float = 0.19
	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
	for i in range(pts.size() - 1):
		var a: Vector3 = pts[i]
		var b: Vector3 = pts[i + 1]
		var d := Vector3(b.x - a.x, 0.0, b.z - a.z)
		if d.length() < 0.05:
			continue
		d = d.normalized()
		var n := Vector3(-d.z, 0.0, d.x) * width * 0.5
		var a0 := Vector3(a.x, y, a.z) + n
		var a1 := Vector3(a.x, y, a.z) - n
		var b0 := Vector3(b.x, y, b.z) + n
		var b1 := Vector3(b.x, y, b.z) - n
		st.add_vertex(a0); st.add_vertex(b0); st.add_vertex(b1)
		st.add_vertex(a0); st.add_vertex(b1); st.add_vertex(a1)
		# 方向箭头：每段中点一个指向前方的三角
		var mid := Vector3((a.x + b.x) * 0.5, y, (a.z + b.z) * 0.5)
		var tip := mid + d * width * 1.15
		var l := mid - d * width * 0.35 + n * 1.15
		var r := mid - d * width * 0.35 - n * 1.15
		st.add_vertex(l); st.add_vertex(tip); st.add_vertex(r)
	st.index()
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	mi.mesh = st.commit()
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	mat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	mat.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	mat.albedo_color = Color(color.r, color.g, color.b, alpha)
	mat.emission_enabled = true
	mat.emission = color
	mat.emission_energy_multiplier = 1.6 if highlight else 0.9
	mat.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	mi.material_override = mat
	mi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
	parent.add_child(mi)

	SfxManager.announce_chain(["welcome", "ready", "attack"])
"}

{"file_path":"C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king\scripts\core\BattleManager.gd","new_string":"func _add_lane_guide(parent: Node3D, pts: Array, color: Color, highlight: bool) -> void:
	var width: float = 4.6 if highlight else 2.8
	var alpha: float = 0.95 if highlight else 0.55
	# 必须高于高地砖面(0.2)与台裙(0.176)，否则光带会被高地压住看不见
	var y: float = 0.26
	# 累计长度 → UV.x（0..1 沿线），UV.y 横跨光带（0..1）
	var total := 0.0
	for i in range(pts.size() - 1):
		total += Vector2(pts[i + 1].x - pts[i].x, pts[i + 1].z - pts[i].z).length()
	total = maxf(total, 0.01)
	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
	var acc := 0.0
	for i in range(pts.size() - 1):
		var a: Vector3 = pts[i]
		var b: Vector3 = pts[i + 1]
		var d := Vector3(b.x - a.x, 0.0, b.z - a.z)
		var seg := d.length()
		if seg < 0.05:
			continue
		d = d / seg
		var n := Vector3(-d.z, 0.0, d.x) * width * 0.5
		var u0 := acc / total
		var u1 := (acc + seg) / total
		acc += seg
		var a0 := Vector3(a.x, y, a.z) + n
		var a1 := Vector3(a.x, y, a.z) - n
		var b0 := Vector3(b.x, y, b.z) + n
		var b1 := Vector3(b.x, y, b.z) - n
		st.set_normal(Vector3.UP)
		st.set_uv(Vector2(u0, 0.0)); st.add_vertex(a0)
		st.set_uv(Vector2(u1, 0.0)); st.add_vertex(b0)
		st.set_uv(Vector2(u1, 1.0)); st.add_vertex(b1)
		st.set_uv(Vector2(u0, 0.0)); st.add_vertex(a0)
		st.set_uv(Vector2(u1, 1.0)); st.add_vertex(b1)
		st.set_uv(Vector2(u0, 1.0)); st.add_vertex(a1)
	st.index()
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	mi.mesh = st.commit()
	var sh := Shader.new()
	sh.code = LANE_GUIDE_SHADER
	var sm := ShaderMaterial.new()
	sm.shader = sh
	sm.set_shader_parameter("lane_color", Color(color.r, color.g, color.b, alpha))
	sm.set_shader_parameter("intensity", 1.0)
	sm.set_shader_parameter("dash_count", 26.0 if highlight else 22.0)
	sm.set_shader_parameter("flow_speed", 0.8 if highlight else 0.55)
	sm.set_meta("lane_fade", true)
	mi.material_override = sm
	mi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
	parent.add_child(mi)
	# 终点柔光环：标出这条路要去的方向（不是终点塔，只是视觉落点）
	var endp: Vector3 = pts[pts.size() - 1]
	var ring_col := Color(color.r, color.g, color.b, 0.5 * alpha)
	var ring := MeshFactory.create_ground_ring(2.6, ring_col, 0.0)
	ring.name = "LaneGoal"
	ring.position = Vector3(endp.x, y, endp.z)
	ring.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
	ring.set_meta("lane_ring", ring_col)
	parent.add_child(ring)

func _process(delta):
	if building_battle:
		return","old_string":"func _add_lane_guide(parent: Node3D, pts: Array, color: Color, highlight: bool) -> void:
	var width: float = 4.2 if highlight else 2.6
	var alpha: float = 0.60 if highlight else 0.34
	var y: float = 0.19
	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
	for i in range(pts.size() - 1):
		var a: Vector3 = pts[i]
		var b: Vector3 = pts[i + 1]
		var d := Vector3(b.x - a.x, 0.0, b.z - a.z)
		if d.length() < 0.05:
			continue
		d = d.normalized()
		var n := Vector3(-d.z, 0.0, d.x) * width * 0.5
		var a0 := Vector3(a.x, y, a.z) + n
		var a1 := Vector3(a.x, y, a.z) - n
		var b0 := Vector3(b.x, y, b.z) + n
		var b1 := Vector3(b.x, y, b.z) - n
		st.add_vertex(a0); st.add_vertex(b0); st.add_vertex(b1)
		st.add_vertex(a0); st.add_vertex(b1); st.add_vertex(a1)
		# 方向箭头：每段中点一个指向前方的三角
		var mid := Vector3((a.x + b.x) * 0.5, y, (a.z + b.z) * 0.5)
		var tip := mid + d * width * 1.15
		var l := mid - d * width * 0.35 + n * 1.15
		var r := mid - d * width * 0.35 - n * 1.15
		st.add_vertex(l); st.add_vertex(tip); st.add_vertex(r)
	st.index()
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	mi.mesh = st.commit()
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	mat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	mat.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	mat.albedo_color = Color(color.r, color.g, color.b, alpha)
	mat.emission_enabled = true
	mat.emission = color
	mat.emission_energy_multiplier = 1.6 if highlight else 0.9
	mat.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	mi.material_override = mat
	mi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
	parent.add_child(mi)

func _process(delta):
	if building_battle:
		return"}

{"file_path":"C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king\scripts\core\BattleManager.gd","new_string":"func _spawn_lane_guides() -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(hero):
		return
	var root := Node3D.new()
	root.name = "LaneGuide"
	add_child(root)
	var blue := Color(0.30, 0.68, 1.0)
	var red := Color(1.0, 0.34, 0.28)
	# 只给"本端玩家"画一条指引：分路取选人页选的分路（打野/游走也有各自的走法）
	var our_team: bool = Config.player_team == Config.Team.PLAYER
	var col: Color = blue if our_team else red
	var lane: String = PlayerPrefs.get_lane()
	if not HeroPickData.LANES.has(lane):
		lane = HeroPickData.role_lane(str(hero.role))
	var pts: Array = _lane_route(lane)
	if not our_team:
		var mirrored: Array = []
		for p: Vector3 in pts:
			mirrored.append(Vector3(-p.x, p.y, -p.z))
		pts = mirrored
	_add_lane_guide(root, pts, col, true)
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_interval(LANE_GUIDE_HOLD)
	tw.tween_method(Callable(self, "_lane_guide_fade").bind(root), 0.0, 1.0, LANE_GUIDE_FADE)
	tw.tween_callback(root.queue_free)

## 玩家分路的地面路线（坐标以我方蓝方基地 (-53,53) 为起点；红方镜像取反）
func _lane_route(lane: String) -> Array:
	match lane:
		"发育路":
			return [Vector3(-53, 0, 53), Vector3(-35, 0, 55), Vector3(-15, 0, 56), Vector3(28, 0, 58)]
		"中路":
			return [Vector3(-53, 0, 53), Vector3(-40, 0, 40), Vector3(-27, 0, 27), Vector3(-14, 0, 14), Vector3(0, 0, 0)]
		"对抗路":
			return [Vector3(-53, 0, 53), Vector3(-55, 0, 35), Vector3(-56, 0, 15), Vector3(-58, 0, -28)]
		"打野":
			# 蓝 buff → 河道岔口 → 红 buff：从自家野区刷起，不走线上
			return [Vector3(-53, 0, 53), Vector3(-40, 0, 20), Vector3(-28, 0, -5), Vector3(-8, 0, 18), Vector3(3, 0, 38)]
		_:
			# 游走：中路起手 → 河道游走（配合中路/发育路）
			return [Vector3(-53, 0, 53), Vector3(-40, 0, 40), Vector3(-27, 0, 27), Vector3(-14, 0, 14),
				Vector3(0, 0, 0), Vector3(14, 0, -14)]","old_string":"func _spawn_lane_guides() -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(hero):

	var red := Color(1.0, 0.34, 0.28)

	var my_lane := _lane_for_role(str(hero.role))     # 玩家推荐分路
	# 我方三条路
	_add_lane_guide(root, [Vector3(-53, 0, 53), Vector3(-35, 0, 55), Vector3(-15, 0, 56), Vector3(28, 0, 58)],

	_add_lane_guide(root, [Vector3(-53, 0, 53), Vector3(-40, 0, 40), Vector3(-27, 0, 27), Vector3(-14, 0, 14)],
		blue, my_lane == "mid")

		blue, my_lane == "clash")

	_add_lane_guide(root, [Vector3(53, 0, -53), Vector3(35, 0, -55), Vector3(15, 0, -56), Vector3(-28, 0, -58)],

	_add_lane_guide(root, [Vector3(53, 0, -53), Vector3(55, 0, -35), Vector3(56, 0, -15), Vector3(58, 0, 28)],
		red, false)
	# 双方泉水标记环：蓝圈 = 我方，红圈 = 敌方
	for i in 2:
		var bx: float = -53.0 if i == 0 else 53.0

		ring.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
		root.add_child(ring)
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_interval(LANE_GUIDE_HOLD)
	tw.tween_method(Callable(self, "_lane_guide_fade").bind(root), 0.0, 1.0, LANE_GUIDE_FADE)
	tw.tween_callback(root.queue_free)"}

{"file_path":"C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king\scripts\core\BattleManager.gd","new_string":"# 选人结束倒计时：全部玩家选定英雄后停留 5 秒（数字 5→1），再切到加载界面
const PICK_COUNTDOWN: float = 5.0

func _play_pick_countdown() -> void:
	var layer := CanvasLayer.new()
	layer.layer = 128
	layer.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	add_child(layer)
	var root := Control.new()
	root.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	root.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	layer.add_child(root)
	var dim := ColorRect.new()
	dim.color = Color(0.02, 0.03, 0.06, 0.58)
	dim.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	dim.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	root.add_child(dim)
	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	vb.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	vb.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	root.add_child(vb)
	var tip := Label.new()
	tip.text = "全部玩家已选定英雄"
	tip.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	tip.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 34)
	tip.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.93, 0.95, 1.0))
	tip.add_theme_color_override("font_outline_color", Color(0, 0, 0, 0.85))
	tip.add_theme_constant_override("outline_size", 6)
	vb.add_child(tip)
	var num := Label.new()
	num.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	num.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 132)
	num.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(1.0, 0.84, 0.30))
	num.add_theme_color_override("font_outline_color", Color(0, 0, 0, 0.9))
	num.add_theme_constant_override("outline_size", 10)
	vb.add_child(num)
	var left := PICK_COUNTDOWN
	while left > 0.0 and is_inside_tree():
		num.text = str(int(ceil(left)))
		await get_tree().create_timer(0.1).timeout
		left -= 0.1
	if is_instance_valid(layer):
		layer.queue_free()

func _start_game(hero_type: String, summoner_id: String = "flash"):
","old_string":"func _start_game(hero_type: String, summoner_id: String = "flash"):

{"file_path":"C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king\scripts\core\BattleManager.gd","new_string":"## 高地到外墙之间的 3m 石台：out_a/out_b 为两条朝外墙的方向，补齐高地直边与城墙间的草缝
## 材质与高度跟高地扇形砖完全一致（同一套以水晶为圆心的同心环砖、砖顶 0.177），
## 这样高地砖 → 台沿 → 外周城墙是一条连续的砖面，直边处不再出现材质/高差错缝
func _add_high_ground_aprons(center: Vector3, out_a: Vector3, out_b: Vector3, brick_center: Vector3) -> void:
	var mat := DecorMesh.hq_ring_brick_material(brick_center)
	var inward_a := -out_a
	var inward_b := -out_b
	# 两条 3m 宽石台，长度取高地半径 35；转角再补 3×3
	_add_flat_quad(center + out_a * 1.5 + inward_b * 17.5, Vector2(3.0, 35.0), mat, 0.177)
	_add_flat_quad(center + out_b * 1.5 + inward_a * 17.5, Vector2(35.0, 3.0), mat, 0.177)
	_add_flat_quad(center + out_a * 1.5 + out_b * 1.5, Vector2(3.0, 3.0), mat, 0.177)","old_string":"## 高地到外墙之间的 3m 石台：out_a/out_b 为两条朝外墙的方向，补齐高地直边与城墙间的草缝
func _add_high_ground_aprons(center: Vector3, out_a: Vector3, out_b: Vector3) -> void:
	var mat := MapVisuals.high_ground_material()
	var inward_a := -out_a
	var inward_b := -out_b
	# 两条 3m 宽石台，长度取高地半径 35；转角再补 3×3
	_add_flat_quad(center + out_a * 1.5 + inward_b * 17.5, Vector2(3.0, 35.0), mat, 0.177)
	_add_flat_quad(center + out_b * 1.5 + inward_a * 17.5, Vector2(35.0, 3.0), mat, 0.177)
	_add_flat_quad(center + out_a * 1.5 + out_b * 1.5, Vector2(3.0, 3.0), mat, 0.177)"}

# 防御塔底座的圆环状青砖：独立挂在 BattleManager 下（不随塔销毁而消失），
# 以塔心为圆心的同心环砖，中间留洞给塔基；塔被摧毁后这圈砖仍然留在原地。
func _add_turret_ring_pave(pos: Vector3, tier: String, team: int) -> void:
	var outer: float = 5.8 if tier == "crystal" else 4.7
	var inner: float = 1.95 if tier == "crystal" else 1.60
	var hq_center := Vector3(-60, 0, 60) if team == Config.Team.PLAYER else Vector3(60, 0, -60)
	var on_high_ground: bool = Vector2(pos.x - hq_center.x, pos.z - hq_center.z).length() < 35.0
	# 顶面：高地砖面 0.177 / 分路路面之上 0.152，都只抬高 1~2mm，避免像旧圆盘那样浮起来露缝
	var top_y: float = 0.177 if on_high_ground else 0.152
	add_child(DecorMesh.turret_ring_pave(pos, inner, outer, top_y))","old_string":"		t.tower_type = str(data["type"])
		t.position = data["pos"]
		add_child(t)
		turrets.append(t)"}

name: pwsh
args:
{"command":"$p = "scripts\core\BattleManager.gd"
$t = Get-Content $p -Raw -Encoding UTF8
$new = @'
func _build_row(idx: int, item_id: String) -> PanelContainer:
	# 装备卡：左侧大图标 + 右侧名称/价格/调序（图标优先、文字压小）
	var item: Dictionary = ItemDatabase.get_item(item_id) if item_id != "" else {}
	var nm := str(item.get("name", item_id))
	var cost := int(item.get("cost", 0))
	var tier := int(item.get("tier", 1))
	var small := int(round(float(_sel_fs(UiKit.FS_XS)) * 0.85))
	var card := PanelContainer.new()
	card.name = "BuildRow_%d" % idx
	card.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 92)
	card.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	var cs: StyleBoxFlat = UiKit.skin_chip(UiKit.C_PANEL_EDGE, 0.8, 10)
	cs.content_margin_left = 6
	cs.content_margin_right = 6
	cs.content_margin_top = 4
	cs.content_margin_bottom = 4
	card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", cs)
	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
	card.add_child(row)
	row.add_child(SelectArt.ItemIcon.new(nm, tier, 56))
	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 2)
	v.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	row.add_child(v)
	var top := HBoxContainer.new()
	top.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 3)
	v.add_child(top)
	var idx_lab := _sel_label("%d." % (idx + 1), small, SEL_GOLD, false)
	idx_lab.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	top.add_child(idx_lab)
	var name_lab := _sel_label(nm, small, SEL_TEXT, false)
	name_lab.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	name_lab.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	name_lab.clip_text = true
	top.add_child(name_lab)
	var price_lab := _sel_label("%d金" % cost, small, SEL_GOLD, false)
	price_lab.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	top.add_child(price_lab)
	var btns := HBoxContainer.new()
	btns.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	btns.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
	v.add_child(btns)
	var up := _sel_btn("↑", UiKit.C_TEAM0, false, Vector2(40, 24))
	up.name = "BuildUp_%d" % idx
	up.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", _sel_fs(UiKit.FS_SM))
	up.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	up.disabled = idx <= 0
	up.pressed.connect(_on_build_move.bind(idx, -1))
	btns.add_child(up)
	var down := _sel_btn("↓", UiKit.C_TEAM0, false, Vector2(40, 24))
	down.name = "BuildDown_%d" % idx
	down.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", _sel_fs(UiKit.FS_SM))
	down.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	down.disabled = idx >= sel_build_ids.size() - 1
	down.pressed.connect(_on_build_move.bind(idx, 1))
	btns.add_child(down)
	return card

'@
$rx = [regex]'(?s)func _build_row\(idx: int, item_id: String\) -> PanelContainer:.*?(?=func _on_build_move\()'
if ($rx.IsMatch($t)) {
  $t = $rx.Replace($t, $new, 1)
  Set-Content $p -Value $t -Encoding UTF8 -NoNewline
  "REPLACED"
} else { "NOT FOUND" }","description":"Rewrite build rows with equipment icons"}

var dragon_minion_type: String = "dragon"
var dragon_minion_budget: int = 9
var dragon_minion_boost: bool = false

## 先锋波数名称（主宰先锋/暗影先锋/风暴先锋）
func vanguard_wave_name() -> String:
	match dragon_minion_type:
		"storm": return "风暴先锋"
		"shadow": return "暗影先锋"
		_: return "主宰先锋"

## 该队伍剩余未出动的先锋波数（budget 按"路次"计，一波 = 3 路）
func vanguard_waves_left(team: int) -> int:
	if dominant_buff_team != team:
		return 0
	var left := dragon_minion_budget - dragon_count
	if left <= 0:
		return 0
	return int(ceil(float(left) / 3.0))

## 当前持有先锋资格的队伍（无则 -1）
func vanguard_owner() -> int:
	return dominant_buff_team
